# Issue labels

Maintainers can create or update these labels under **Issues → Labels**. This document does not create labels automatically. Create them before relying on automatic labels in issue forms.

| Label | Suggested color | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `good first issue` | `7057ff` | A bounded task with reproduction/context, likely files, and clear acceptance criteria. Add only after triage. |
| `help wanted` | `008672` | A task where external contributions would be useful. |
| `documentation` | `0075ca` | Setup instructions, examples, reference material, or broken links. |
| `bug` | `d73a4a` | Reported incorrect behavior; the label alone does not confirm a diagnosis. |
| `enhancement` | `a2eeef` | Proposed changes to behavior or capabilities, pending scope review. |
| `extraction` | `1d76db` | Document parsing, citations, or line-item matching. |
| `data-quality` | `fbca04` | Incorrect or ambiguous extracted/normalized values. |

Use `documentation` with `good first issue` only when a task is actually suitable for a newcomer. Do not create placeholder issues or apply labels merely to make the repository look active. Report vulnerabilities through [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md), not public issue labels.
